items.ask:
What differs: with the flag the moving color band is a layer that slides under a fixed text mask, instead of a background that moves inside the text. In the CI strips (run 41261936045) the word shapes are the same. The color differs by at most 5 of 255 in Chromium and 8 of 255 in WebKit, only along the edge of the moving band (at 0.5 s and 2 s) and in a few pixels in the first two frames; at loop progress 0 there is no difference. An earlier test page (run 40336086853) found, in Chromium at progress 0, nine pixels in the last column of the last letter that differ, three of them by 33 of 255; WebKit differed by at most 2 inside the word.
What it buys: at the end of the page the page does about 100 style recalculations per 100 frames with the flag, against about 200 without it (iOS Simulator, runs 41212638765, 41215962130 and 41219277317; the phone is not measured).
What the strips are not: they come from a test page that restates the site's sweep CSS and font at device pixel ratio 1, not from the built site. The Flag, Faithful and Compare buttons open the real site.
Keep the flag as a look change, or reject it?

items.title: Review the look change nav:earn-no-transition

items.ask:
What differs: with the flag the moving color band is a layer that slides under a fixed text mask, instead of a background that moves inside the text. In the CI strips (run 41261936045) the word shapes are the same. The color differs by at most 5 of 255 in Chromium and 8 of 255 in WebKit, only along the edge of the moving band (at 0.5 s and 2 s) and in a few pixels in the first two frames; at loop progress 0 there is no difference. An earlier test page (run 40336086853) found, in Chromium at progress 0, nine pixels in the last column of the last letter that differ, three of them by 33 of 255; WebKit differed by at most 2 inside the word.
What it buys: at the end of the page the page does about 100 style recalculations per 100 frames with the flag, against about 200 without it (iOS Simulator, runs 41212638765, 41215962130 and 41219277317; the phone is not measured).
What the strips are not: they come from a test page that restates the site's sweep CSS and font at device pixel ratio 1, not from the built site. The Flag, Faithful and Compare buttons open the real site.
Keep the flag as a look change, or reject it?
